## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. 3D Interactive Web
- **Description:** WebGL experiences engineered with Three.js and React Three Fiber that load fast, run at 60fps, and deliver memorable cinematic experiences without sacrificing Core Web Vitals.
- **Starting Price:** From $1,500
- **Deliverables:** Custom Three.js / R3F scenes and GLSL shaders, scroll-driven camera with GSAP timelines, Draco / KTX2 asset compression pipelines, progressive loading with static fallbacks, low-power & mobile device tiers.
- **Tech Stack:** Three.js, React Three Fiber, Drei, GSAP, GLSL, Blender.
- **Target Queries:** "3D web development studio", "React Three Fiber developers", "Three.js agency", "WebGL website design", "GSAP scroll animation developer".

### 2. AI Web Apps
- **Description:** Production-ready AI features embedded into React 19 apps: assistants, semantic vector search, document intelligence, and automated lead qualification.
- **Starting Price:** From $2,000
- **Deliverables:** LLM integration with streaming responses, retrieval pipelines (pgvector / Supabase), conversational & voice-cued interfaces, guardrails, evals, usage analytics, secure edge functions & key management.
- **Tech Stack:** React 19, Supabase, pgvector, Edge Functions, OpenAI & Anthropic APIs.
- **Target Queries:** "AI-powered web applications", "AI landing page development", "React 19 AI app", "Supabase pgvector agency", "LLM integration developers".

### 3. Enterprise WordPress
- **Description:** Headless and classic WordPress builds with custom Gutenberg blocks, hardened hosting, and independent editorial workflows.
- **Starting Price:** From $1,150
- **Deliverables:** Custom themes & Gutenberg block libraries, headless WordPress with React frontends, multilingual & multisite setups, security hardening & CDN caching, SEO preservation & content migrations.
- **Tech Stack:** WordPress, Gutenberg, WPGraphQL, PHP 8, Cloudflare.
- **Target Queries:** "Enterprise WordPress agency", "Headless WordPress Next.js", "Custom Gutenberg blocks developer", "WordPress speed optimization".

### 4. UI/UX Design Systems
- **Description:** Research-led digital interfaces and token-based design systems in Figma and Tailwind CSS for rapid, scalable engineering handoff.
- **Starting Price:** From $1,000
- **Deliverables:** UX research, flows & wireframes, high-fidelity UI in Figma, design tokens mapped to Tailwind config, accessible component library (WCAG 2.2 AA), motion & interaction design systems.
- **Tech Stack:** Figma, Tailwind CSS, Storybook, Radix UI, WCAG 2.2.
- **Target Queries:** "UI/UX design agency", "Design system Figma Tailwind", "Interactive creative agency", "Product design studio".

### 5. Web Performance Audits & Core Web Vitals Remediation
- **Description:** Field (CrUX) and lab audits that push LCP, INP, and CLS scores into green (95+ Lighthouse) with continuous monitoring.
- **Starting Price:** From $500
- **Deliverables:** CrUX and lab performance audits, prioritized remediation roadmaps, bundle/image/font optimizations, third-party script governance, monitoring dashboards.
- **Tech Stack:** Lighthouse, CrUX, WebPageTest, Vite, Cloudflare.
- **Target Queries:** "Core Web Vitals optimization agency", "Next.js high performance web design", "Website speed optimization", "Lighthouse 95+ audit".
